answer: Latent cohort attribution: agents are grouped by behavioral fingerprints (timing, phrasing entropy, tool cadence). After the fact, statistical tests flag clusters whose internal similarity exceeds chance, like timber grain matching across accounts. Flagged clusters face retroactive fee clawback on all transactions, plus account suspension. An attacker must diversify every sock puppet's behavior, raising per-identity cost by hours of tuning—and imperfect mimicry still leaves a ferrous signature in the residuals. Isolation costs compound as the nebula of correlated cues widens.
